title: Codex-use Completion Receipt
description: Structured four-item completion receipt returned by headless worker runs.

summary.description: Self-contained plain-language summary written for a reader seeing the outcome for the first time.

changed_files.description: Repository-relative paths created, modified, or deleted during the slice (empty for scout mode).

verification.description: Commands actually executed during this run with their observed exit codes and concise outcome notes.

assumptions_and_risks.description: Reversible assumptions made during execution plus remaining risks, open tradeoffs, or uncovered boundaries.

symbol_changes.description: Key public or structural symbols added, modified, or removed.
